trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If the supplier would have delivered, we would have sold more.
trap.right: If the supplier had delivered, we would have sold more.
trap.why: Português “se tivesse entregado”; o brasileiro usa would na oração com if. No 3º condicional: if + had + particípio.

mcq.q: If the shop **___** opened, we would have bought it.
We **___** profits if prices had fallen.

opts: If I had saved, I would have bought it.
If I would save, I had bought it.
If I saved, I would have bought it.

fix.wrong: If demand had grew, prices had risen.
fix.right: If demand had grown, prices would have risen.

fix.wrong: If we would have known, we would have waited.
fix.right: If we had known, we would have waited.

fix.wrong: If she had paid, she will have received it.
fix.right: If she had paid, she would have received it.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 3º: “If the supplier delivers, we sell more.”
rewrite.answer: If the supplier had delivered, we would have sold more.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa na if: “If prices had risen.” (not)
Inverta as cláusulas: “If I had known, I would have waited.”
rewrite.answer: I would have waited if I had known.
